speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

zh: 我们必须确保我们对工匠精神以及公司所代表的东西抱有极大的自豪感。

speaker: Unknown
en: Everything is your job.
zh: 一切都是你的工作。

zh: 你知道，我也认识到并 appreciates 那些系统思考者的资深运营者的价值。

en: Because if you had everyone at Cisco who was a founder, it'd be a shit show.

zh: 所以你必须确保取得一个好的平衡。

zh: 第二个三分之一是我从外部引入的人，从竞争对手、从市场引入的，非常懂市场的人。

speaker: Unknown
en: That might not know how to maneuver Cisco, but they're systems thinkers, and they've operated at scale.

speaker: Unknown
en: And then the third third are co-founders and CEOs of companies that we've acquired.
zh: 然后最后三分之一是我们收购的公司的联合创始人和 CEO。

speaker: Unknown
en: But those people, we give them charters that are larger than the company that they've sold us.
zh: 而对这些人，我们给他们的使命范围比他们卖给我们的那家公司还要大。

speaker: Unknown
en: You said earlier that this way of operating is especially important in wartime.
zh: 你之前说过，这种运营方式在战时尤其重要。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think we are now squarely in the AI infrastructure game, which is something that no one would give us credit for three, four years ago.
zh: 我认为我们现在已经稳稳地身处 AI 基础设施这场游戏中，这是三四年前没人会认可我们的事。

speaker: Unknown

en: That means you have to operate at speed, but with scale.

speaker: Unknown
en: If you just operate at speed, then you're just a startup.

speaker: Unknown
en: If you just operate at scale, then you're just the largest company.
zh: 如果你只以规模运营，那你就只是一家最大的公司。

en: If you want to operate as the world's largest startup, it has to be with speed and scale.
zh: 如果你想作为世界上最大的初创公司来运营，就必须兼具速度和规模。

speaker: Unknown
en: What are the key things you need to get right in the next few years to seize that opportunity?
zh: 在未来几年里，你需要做对哪些关键的事情才能抓住这个机会？

zh: 让我们现在假设，只有不到2%的人类在以任何形式的强力用户身份使用智能体。

en: We are supply constrained with only sub 2% of the people using agents.

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown
en: The amount of infrastructure you're going to need is going to be at a very different scale proportion that we have right now.
zh: 你所需要的基础设施规模，将会与我们现在的规模完全不成比例。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we want to make sure that we can help solve that problem.
zh: 而我们想确保我们能够帮助解决这个问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's problem number one.

speaker: Unknown
en: Problem number two is these agents, in fact, this week was a very interesting week because these agents are going to go rogue at times.

speaker: Unknown
en: They might actually have a mind of their own.

speaker: Unknown
en: The paperclip optimizer problem.
zh: 回形针优化器问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: Exactly.
zh: 正是。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so what we have to have is you have to have some kind of safety, security, and observability.
zh: 所以我们必须拥有的是，你必须有某种安全性、安保性和可观测性。

speaker: Unknown
en: Capabilities in place.
zh: 能力到位。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so that's the second big problem that we want to solve is we want to make sure that AI is safe to use for everyone and that that doesn't become this constant fear because of which people don't use AI.

zh: 我们是世界上最大的提供基础设施的网络公司之一。

speaker: Unknown
en: We are also one of the largest security companies in the world.
zh: 我们也是世界上最大的安全公司之一。

speaker: Unknown
en: We want to make sure that we do that.
zh: 我们要确保做到这一点。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we are also one of the most significant kind of machine data companies in the world with Splunk.
zh: 我们还凭借 Splunk 成为世界上最重要的机器数据公司之一。

speaker: Unknown
en: Oh, that's right.
zh: 哦，没错。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so the combination of those three should give us all of the underlying apparatus that's needed so that we can become critical infrastructure for the critical infrastructure companies for the AI era.
zh: 所以这三者的结合应该能给我们提供所有所需的基础装置，让我们能够成为 AI 时代关键基础设施公司的关键基础设施。

speaker: Unknown

zh: 你们已经在 AI 上全力以赴了，既体现在投资 AI 数据中心市场方面，也体现在把 AI 引入 Cisco 让一切更高效方面。

speaker: Unknown

zh: 我其实非常想知道，在 Cisco 这样规模的公司采用 AI 是什么样子。

speaker: Unknown
en: It can't be around efficiency.
zh: 它不能围绕效率。

speaker: Unknown
en: The goal is not efficiency.
zh: 目标不是效率。

speaker: Unknown
en: The goal is to be able to go out and make sure that we benefit from the original insights that AI generates that allow us to solve problems we could have never dreamt of solving before, which is very different from just get to be 20% faster at doing this or make sure that you have less people.

speaker: Unknown
en: In fact, my strong assumption is moving forward that we will actually need more engineers, not less.
zh: 事实上，我对未来的强烈假设是，我们实际上需要更多的工程师，而不是更少。

speaker: Unknown
en: As we move forward, because every single time I've seen a step function improvement in AI, I've seen a bottleneck that's emerged that's a human bottleneck.
zh: 随着我们向前走，因为每一次我看到 AI 出现阶跃式改进，我都会看到涌现出一个瓶颈，那是人类的瓶颈。

speaker: Unknown
en: Coding is automated.

speaker: Unknown
en: Code review becomes a bottleneck.

speaker: Unknown
en: Code review is automated.

speaker: Unknown
en: Judgment on what to build and what not to build becomes a bottleneck.

speaker: Unknown
en: So I do feel like we're going to need to have more people.
zh: 所以我确实觉得我们会需要更多的人。

speaker: Unknown
en: But what was interesting was getting 32,000 engineers.

speaker: Unknown

zh: 我去找了一个我认识的人，他是个银行家，我问他，我需要二十五万美元。

speaker: Unknown
en: And he said, why do you need a quarter million dollars?
zh: 他说，你为什么需要二十五万美元？

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm like, I'm going to buy this company.
zh: 我说，我要买下这家公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: He goes, what are you going to do when you buy the company?
zh: 他说，你买下公司之后打算做什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm going to run it.
zh: 我说，我要经营它。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now remember, I wasn't a founder of this company.
zh: 现在要记住，我当时并不是这家公司的创始人。

speaker: Unknown
en: I was an intern.
zh: 我是一个实习生。

speaker: Unknown
en: You were an intern.
zh: 你当时是个实习生。

speaker: Unknown
en: You were still in college at the time.
zh: 你那时还在上大学。

speaker: Unknown
en: I had just, the first loan I took was $10,000.
zh: 我刚，我借的第一笔贷款是一万美元。

speaker: Unknown
en: The second loan I took was $250,000.
zh: 我借的第二笔贷款是二十五万美元。

speaker: Unknown
en: But the first loan I took, I was still in college.
zh: 但我借第一笔贷款的时候，我还在上大学。

speaker: Unknown
en: I was minimum wage, right?
zh: 我拿着最低工资，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: And I said, give me some money and I'll pay it back to you.
zh: 我说，借我点钱，我会还给你的。

speaker: Unknown
en: He said, 10% interest.
zh: 他说，10% 的利息。

speaker: Unknown
en: I ran that business for 17 years.
zh: 我经营那门生意经营了 17 年。

speaker: Unknown
en: And now it's like a sub $5 million company.
zh: 现在它是一家低于 500 万美元规模的公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: You stayed there for 17 years?
zh: 你在那里待了 17 年？

speaker: Unknown
en: It was in some ways my biggest mistake in my career.
zh: 某种程度上这是我职业生涯中最大的错误。

speaker: Unknown
en: Not because the company wasn't good, it's because the business model did not align with what I wanted to do in life.
zh: 不是因为公司不好，而是因为那个商业模式和我想在生活中做的事情并不一致。

speaker: Unknown
en: And sometimes, you know, like our CEO, Chuck, tells me, he's like, Jitu, once you actually go public, you can't alter your business model that much.
zh: 有时候，你知道，像我们的 CEO Chuck 告诉我，他说，Jitu,一旦你真正上市了，你就不能大幅改变你的商业模式了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Your business model is your business model.
zh: 你的商业模式就是你的商业模式。

speaker: Unknown
en: It takes a lot of effort to alter your business model.
zh: 改变商业模式需要花很大的力气。

speaker: Unknown
en: But when you're in a services business, this was kind of a market research company in a services business,
zh: 而当你在一家服务型企业里——这当时算是一家服务型行业里的市场调研公司——

speaker: Unknown
en: And I loved software and I loved Silicon Valley.
zh: 而我热爱软件，我热爱硅谷。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I used to come here and I had an apartment in Russian Hill for a while.
zh: 我以前常来这里，有一段时间我在 Russian Hill 有一间公寓。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I would come here and I'd just be enamored with the people in Silicon Valley.
zh: 我会来这里，就是被硅谷的人们深深吸引。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I'm like, I want to go work with these folks because the decision they make and that start button in Windows is going to be affecting billions of people.
zh: 我就想，我想去和这些人一起工作，因为他们做的决定，还有 Windows 里那个开始按钮，将影响数十亿人。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I want to be that person, you know?
zh: 我想成为那样的人，你知道吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: But I never really was getting that same level of satisfaction from that.
zh: 但我从来没有从那份工作中得到同等程度的满足感。

speaker: Unknown
en: But I stayed on there because of ego.
zh: 但我留在了那里，因为自尊心。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this is the other lesson I'll give to founders.
zh: 这是我要给创始人的另一个教训。

speaker: Unknown
en: I stayed on there because I had this ego that I will never work for someone else.
zh: 我留在那里是因为我有这样一种自尊心：我绝不为别人打工。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is my own company.
zh: 这是我自己的公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm my own boss.
zh: 我是我自己的老板。

speaker: Unknown
en: I don't want to work for someone else.
zh: 我不想为别人工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: Biggest mistake I made because ego drove my decision rather than learning driving my decision.
zh: 这是我犯下的最大错误，因为驱动我决定的是自尊心，而不是学习成长。

speaker: Unknown
en: So finally, I decided to go work at EMC.
zh: 所以最后，我决定去 EMC 工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the guy who hired me at EMC is still my coach.
zh: 而在 EMC 雇我的那个人至今仍是我的教练。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we were having dinner.
zh: 我们当时在一起吃晚饭。

speaker: Unknown
en: EMC, huge company.
zh: EMC,一家巨大的公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: Huge company.
zh: 巨大的公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: 60,000 people, right?
zh: 六万人，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm going from like 25 people to 60,000 people.
zh: 我是从大约 25 人的公司跳到六万人的公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: He's hiring me as a CTO.
zh: 他雇我担任 CTO。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we're having dinner like this across the table.
zh: 我们就这样隔着桌子一起吃晚饭。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I'm like, his name is Rick Devenuti.
zh: 我想说，他叫 Rick Devenuti。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I said, Rick, you got to pay me more because I've had 17 years of experience.
zh: 我说，Rick,你得多付我一些钱，因为我有 17 年的经验了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I said, Jitu, you don't have 17 years of experience.
zh: 我说,Jitu,你没有 17 年的经验。

speaker: Unknown
en: You have one year of experience 17 times over.
zh: 你只有一年的经验,重复了 17 次。

speaker: Unknown
en: Come work for me.
zh: 来为我工作吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: And in the first year, I'll give you 17 years of experience.
zh: 第一年,我就会给你 17 年的经验。

speaker: Unknown
en: I learned more from him in the first year than I did in the 17 years running my own business.
zh: 我在第一年从他那里学到的,比我经营自己公司的 17 年学到的还要多。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was absolutely magical.
zh: 在 Box,在我管理全部产品的那段时间里,我们把业务从 2 亿做到了 8 亿。

speaker: Unknown
en: I hated working for him during that time.
zh: 那段时间我很讨厌为他工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: But after we left and I went to Box,
zh: 但在我们离开、我去 Box 之后,

speaker: Unknown
en: There's this person that is my co-founder in life.
zh: 有这样一个人,她是我人生中的联合创始人。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think of like, you know, she is, she's my head of operations.
zh: 我是一个智力非常普通的人。

speaker: Unknown
en: I don't take a job without her.
zh: 没有她我不会接任何工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: Her and I would always be like, what would Rick do at this point?
zh: 我和她总是会问,这种时候 Rick 会怎么做?

speaker: Unknown
en: And we kept asking ourselves that.
zh: 我们一直在问自己这个问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so that was a great mentor to have.
zh: 所以那是一位很棒的导师。

speaker: Unknown
en: Then I went to Box.
zh: 然后我去了 Box。

speaker: Unknown
en: Box, we took that business from 200 to 800 million during my time that I ran all product by the end of it.
zh: Box,在我掌管所有产品的那段时间里,我们把那项业务从 2 亿做到了 8 亿。

speaker: Unknown
en: Then I was going to go run advertising for a fang company.
zh: 后来我打算去一家 fang 公司负责广告业务。

speaker: Unknown
en: Not at all anything to do with Cisco.
zh: 跟 Cisco 完全没有任何关系。

speaker: Unknown
en: I had accepted the job, but the kind of offer they were going to give to Jessie, who was with me, was not the right offer for her.
zh: 我已经接受了那份工作,但他们准备给 Jessie 的录用条件——她一直跟着我——对她来说并不合适。

speaker: Unknown
en: And she was my co-founder in life.
zh: 而她是我人生中的联合创始人。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like, I was not going to go anywhere without her because she stuck with me the whole time.
zh: 就是说,没有她我哪儿都不会去,因为她全程都跟我在一起。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so I'm like, okay, so I need to figure out what to do.
zh: 所以我就想,好,我得想想该怎么办。

speaker: Unknown
en: And literally, happenstance,
zh: 然后真的是机缘巧合,

speaker: Unknown
en: Chuck calls me the next day and says, hey, you should probably think of coming here.
zh: Chuck 第二天打给我说,嘿,你应该考虑来这里。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I told him, I'm like, hey, look, I've already accepted this job.
zh: 我告诉他,嘿,你看,我已经接受了那份工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: And he said to me, he's like, that company will do well with or without you.
zh: 他对我说,那家公司有你没你都会做得很好。

speaker: Unknown
en: But if you come to Cisco, the trajectory will be shaped based on what you do.
zh: 但如果你来 Cisco,公司的轨迹将取决于你做什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then it was like sold.
zh: 然后就像是成交了。

speaker: Unknown
en: He gave us two offers within nine days.
zh: 他在九天内给了我们两份 offer。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you knew that the company was willing to work at a very fast clock speed.
zh: 所以你知道这家公司愿意以非常快的时钟速度运转。

speaker: Unknown
en: The question I asked him was, I'm like, how much freedom are you going to give me to just be very product obsessed?
zh: 我问他的问题是,我说,你打算给我多大的自由,让我可以完全专注于产品?

speaker: Unknown
en: And he said, yeah, we'd love you to be product obsessed.
zh: 他说,是啊,我们很希望你专注于产品。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so we did that.
zh: 于是我们就这么做了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And before you know it, Cisco became the place where I think I got some of my...
zh: 转眼之间,Cisco 成为了……我想我在那里获得了……

speaker: Unknown
en: In my career, the largest amount of growth I've had is probably in the past six years.
zh: 在我的职业生涯中,我成长最多的时期大概就是过去的六年。

speaker: Unknown
en: What are some lessons that you'd share with someone who is like you at 19 or so, perhaps even growing up in India or someplace outside of the valley where they're looking in from the outside?
zh: 你会分享哪些经验给那些像 19 岁时的你的人,也许是在印度长大,或是在硅谷之外、从外部观望的人?

speaker: Unknown
en: I think the first lesson I would say is your upper limit is typically bound by your own ambition.
zh: 我想说第一条经验是:你的上限通常受限于你自己的野心,

speaker: Unknown
en: rather than any other kind of factor.
zh: 而不是任何其他因素。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's not generally your ability.
zh: 通常不是你的能力问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm a very averagely intelligent person.
zh: 我是一个非常智力平平的人。

speaker: Unknown
en: I didn't have a fancy degree from a fancy school, but I was hungrier than everyone else.
zh: 我没有名牌学校的漂亮学历,但我比其他所有人都更饥饿。

speaker: Unknown
en: I still am hungrier than most people I work with.
zh: 我现在仍然比我共事的大多数人更饥饿。

speaker: Unknown
en: Not because they're not hungry, but because I just feel like I don't want to let them down.
zh: 不是因为他们不饥饿,而是因为我觉得我不想让他们失望。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so I'm just going to keep going at it.
zh: 所以我就要继续拼下去。

speaker: Unknown
en: And there's no one who can tell me that I'm not putting in the time.
zh: 没有人能告诉我说我没有投入时间。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that I think is the first thing is put in the time, think really big and have very bold ambitions.
zh: 我认为第一件事就是投入时间,想得足够大,并拥有非常大胆的野心。

speaker: Unknown
en: Because if your imagination, like imagination can tend to curtail us much more than we give it credit for.
zh: 因为想象力,想象力对我们的束缚往往比我们以为的要大得多。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you have your goal that's this big, chances are you'll never get here.
zh: 如果你的目标是这么大,那你很可能永远到不了那里。

speaker: Unknown
en: But if you have your goal that's over here, and if you get here, that's pretty good.
zh: 但如果你的目标是那么大,而如果你达到了,那已经相当不错了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so that's a pretty important dimension to keep in mind.
zh: 所以这是一个需要记住的非常重要的维度。

speaker: Unknown
en: The second one is business is a team sport.
zh: 第二点是,生意是一项团队运动。

speaker: Unknown
en: Take pride and longevity of relationships that you can build where you have actually made other people successful as a function of you.
zh: 为你能够建立的长久关系感到自豪,在这些关系中,你确实让别人因你而取得了成功。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that, I think, will go a really long way.
zh: 而我认为,这会带来非常长远的回报。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if you think that way from the time you're 19,
zh: 如果你从 19 岁起就这么想,

speaker: Unknown
en: Boy, the advantage that you have is tremendously high, you know?
zh: 天哪,你拥有的优势会极其巨大,你知道吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: And then the third area that I usually tell founders about is this notion of power of compounding.
zh: 然后我通常告诉创始人的第三个领域,就是复利的力量这个概念。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like, you just have to get 1.27% better today than yesterday.
zh: 就是说,你只需要今天比昨天好 1.27%。

speaker: Unknown
en: And within a year, you're 100x better.
zh: 一年之内,你就会好 100 倍。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if you do that for 10 years, like, that's pretty good.
zh: 如果你坚持这样做 10 年,那已经相当不错了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And 10 years in the grand scheme of things, it feels like a long time when you're 19.
zh: 而 10 年,从宏观角度来看,当你 19 岁的时候,感觉像是很长一段时间。

speaker: Unknown
en: Sam Altman had this blog he had written once.
zh: Sam Altman 曾经写过这样一篇博客。

speaker: Unknown
en: The days are long, but the decades are short.
zh: 日子很漫长,但几十年很短暂。

speaker: Unknown
en: I read that every year.
zh: 唯一的区别是,要在商业模式真正合理的时候坚持苦干,但不要像我那样,在一个其实不符合你雄心的生意里苦苦坚持。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's an amazing blog post.
zh: 那是一篇非常了不起的博客文章。

speaker: Unknown
en: It is one of the best blog posts he's written.
zh: 这是他写过的最好的博客文章之一。

speaker: Unknown
en: Jeff Bezos will say, the ability for someone, for a founder to think in a 20-year window versus a three-month window changes the quality of decisions you make materially.
zh: Jeff Bezos 会说,一个人、一个创始人以 20 年的窗口来思考,而不是以三个月的窗口来思考,会实质性地改变你所做决策的质量。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if you think about the really
zh: 而如果你想想那些真正

speaker: Unknown
en: Big entrepreneurs that we all respect, think about Jensen, think about Elon Musk.
zh: 为我们所敬重的大企业家,想想 Jensen,想想 Elon Musk。

speaker: Unknown
en: None of them were accused of thinking in very short-term windows.
zh: 他们没有一个被指责用非常短期的窗口来思考。

speaker: Unknown
en: I mean, they grinded it out for a long time.
zh: 我是说,他们长期艰苦地坚持了下来。

speaker: Unknown
en: The only difference is grind it out when the business model actually makes sense, but don't do it like what I did and grind it out in a business which doesn't actually fit your ambitions.
zh: 唯一的区别是,在商业模式真正说得通的时候坚持熬下去,但不要像我当年那样,在一个其实不符合你抱负的业务里硬熬。

speaker: Unknown
en: Because my business, the one that I ran, was great for a lifestyle business.
zh: 因为我的生意,我经营的那一家,作为生活方式型生意是很棒的。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was terrible.
zh: 它很糟糕,

speaker: Unknown
en: to go change the world.
zh: 作为去改变世界的方式。

speaker: Unknown
en: I wanted to go change the world.
zh: 我想要去改变世界。

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, that's the wrong business to be in to go change the world.
zh: 你知道,那不是去改变世界的正确生意。

speaker: Unknown
en: But if you want it to be a good lifestyle business and have it be a thing that provided well for your family, fantastic.
zh: 但如果你想要一个不错的生活方式型生意,让它能很好地供养你的家庭,那太好了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Keep doing that.
zh: 继续做下去。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's great.
zh: 那很棒。

speaker: Unknown
en: And by the way, none of those are wrong answers.
zh: 顺便说一句,这些答案没有哪一个是错的。

speaker: Unknown
en: It just happens to be that the one that I, my ambition did not align with the model of the business, which is the other thing you have to keep in mind is, does your ambition align with what you're actually doing right now?
zh: 只不过是我的雄心与生意的模式不匹配,这是你必须记住的另一件事:你的雄心是否与你现在实际在做的事情相匹配?

speaker: Unknown
en: Where you are going to get fulfilled when you look back when you're 80 and say, you know what?
zh: 当你 80 岁回头看时,你会感到满足,并说,你知道吗?

speaker: Unknown
en: I feel very good that this is how I spent my time.
zh: 我对自己这样度过时间感到非常欣慰。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think that's a question we should keep asking ourselves.
zh: 我认为这是我们应该不断问自己的问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: And for the younger folks, I always tell them time's going to pass by so fast.
zh: 而对年轻人,我总是告诉他们,时间会过得非常快。

speaker: Unknown
en: I never thought I'd be 55.
zh: 我从没想过我会 55 岁。

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, I never thought I'd be called uncle.
zh: 你知道,我从没想过我会被叫叔叔。

speaker: Unknown
en: I never thought I would have a kid.
zh: 我从没想过我会有一个孩子。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I never thought that she would say, Dad, you're old, you know, and bald.
zh: 我也从没想过她会说,爸爸,你老了,还秃头,你知道吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so like those things sometimes give you a lot of humility that you have to make sure that you don't take time for granted and spend the time in the places that actually really matter.
zh: 所以,这些事情有时会让你非常谦卑,让你必须确保不把时间视为理所当然,把时间花在真正重要的地方。

speaker: Unknown
en: What advice would you have for entrepreneurs or for people who are coming into an organization like Cisco and trying to transform it the way that you did?
zh: 对于那些创业者,或者那些进入像 Cisco 这样的组织、并试图像你那样去变革它的人,你会有什么建议?

speaker: Unknown
en: I'll give you the story.
zh: 我给你讲个故事。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I hadn't gone back to India from the time I left India.
zh: 自从我离开印度之后,我一直没回过印度。

speaker: Unknown
en: 1991, I left.
zh: 1991 年,我离开了。

speaker: Unknown
en: My dad died in 2004.
zh: 我父亲于 2004 年去世。

speaker: Unknown
en: I had gone to see him for 48 hours once before he died.
zh: 在他去世前,我只去看过他一次,待了 48 小时。

speaker: Unknown
en: But then I hadn't gone back until 2017.
zh: 但在那之后,我一直没回去过,直到 2017 年。

speaker: Unknown
en: So for any kind of practical purpose from 1991 to 2017, I hadn't spent that much time in India.
zh: 所以从任何实际意义上说,从 1991 年到 2017 年,我没在印度待过多少时间。

speaker: Unknown
en: I took my daughter there.
zh: 我带女儿去了那里。

speaker: Unknown
en: We went to the Taj Mahal, and there's this tour guide.
zh: 我们去了泰姬陵,有一位导游。

speaker: Unknown
en: His name is Raj.
zh: 他叫 Raj。

speaker: Unknown
en: He's showing us the Taj Mahal.
zh: 他带我们参观泰姬陵。

speaker: Unknown
en: The guide seemed like a really good product guy.
zh: 这个导游看起来是个非常优秀的产品人。

speaker: Unknown
en: He knew every single detail about his product, which was the experience he was selling about the Taj Mahal.
zh: 他了解他的产品的每一个细节，也就是他出售的关于泰姬陵的体验。

speaker: Unknown
en: But then people would keep walking by, and he would actually bust out in different languages, Mandarin and German and French and Spanish.
zh: 但不断有人从旁边走过，他真的会用不同的语言开口讲解，普通话、德语、法语、西班牙语。

speaker: Unknown
en: At some point, I'm like, dude, how many languages do you speak?
zh: 有一次我忍不住问，老兄，你会说多少种语言？

speaker: Unknown
en: He gave me like some ridiculously large number, like 12 or 14 languages or something like that.
zh: 他给了我一个大得离谱的数字，大概 12 或 14 种语言之类的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so I said, that's crazy.
zh: 于是我说，太疯狂了。

speaker: Unknown
en: He's like, well, you know, I want to honor the people that come here because they come here and I should not be presumptuous enough to think that they're going to speak my language.
zh: 他说，你知道吗，我想尊重来这里的人，因为他们来到这里，我不应该傲慢地认为他们会说我的语言。

speaker: Unknown
en: I should speak their language.
zh: 我应该说他们的语言。

speaker: Unknown
en: I mean, that's very noble.
zh: 我说，这非常高尚。

speaker: Unknown
en: Clearly a smart dude.
zh: 显然是个聪明人。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm thinking to myself, I'm like, this guy is smarter than anyone.
zh: 我心里在想，这家伙比任何人都聪明。

speaker: Unknown
en: I used to work at Box at the time.
zh: 我当时在 Box 工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: Anyone that I work with, he's making probably $10 a day.
zh: 和我共事的所有人，他大概一天挣 10 美元。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm sitting here in Silicon Valley.
zh: 而我坐在硅谷这里。

speaker: Unknown
en: And why is that?
zh: 为什么会这样？

speaker: Unknown
en: Because I happen to have a platform and he doesn't, right?
zh: 因为我恰好拥有一个平台，而他没有，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: I have a platform of education.
zh: 我有教育的平台。

speaker: Unknown
en: I have a platform of America.
zh: 我有美国的平台。

speaker: Unknown
en: I have a platform of tech.
zh: 我有科技行业的平台。

speaker: Unknown
en: I have a platform that just gives me the affordance of opportunity that he didn't get.
zh: 我拥有的平台给了我他所没有得到的机会资源。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so no matter how smart he was, no matter how hard he's working,
zh: 所以无论他多聪明，无论他多努力，

speaker: Unknown
en: He's having a hard time breaking away from the pack.
zh: 他都很难从人群中突围出来。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you happen to be afforded a platform, my only ask of people is don't squander it.
zh: 如果你恰好被赋予了一个平台，我唯一的要求是不要浪费它。

speaker: Unknown
en: And as a founder, you know, like we could all look at all the things as glass half empty and these are the things that we don't have.
zh: 作为创始人，你知道，我们都可以把所有事情看得像杯子只剩一半那样悲观，想着这些是我们没有的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: But man, we are all living in one of the most special times.
zh: 但是天哪，我们都生活在一个最特别的时代。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if you're 19 or 20 or in the earlier part of your career,
zh: 如果你现在 19 岁或 20 岁，或者处于职业生涯的早期，

speaker: Unknown
en: In this moment in time during the movement in AI, do you know how many people in their 50s, how much money they would pay to get back to being 19 if they could?
zh: 在 AI 浪潮中的这个时刻，你知道有多少 50 多岁的人愿意付多少钱来回到 19 岁吗，如果他们能的话？

speaker: Unknown
en: This is a magical time to be alive in tech.
zh: 这是一个活在科技界的神奇时代。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is a great time to actually make an impact in the world.
zh: 这是一个真正在世界上产生影响的绝佳时代。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if you are spending your time associated with YC, which is one of the finest organizations, I think, which is why I love working with you folks, you would be nuts not to just bust your tail and do everything you can.
zh: 而且如果你正把时间花在与 YC 相关的事情上——我认为 YC 是最优秀的组织之一，这也是我喜欢与你们合作的原因——你不拼尽全力、不做一切努力就是疯了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Not for any other reason, not for making the money, but because the impact you'll have on society at large will be so gratifying when you're older.
zh: 不是为了别的，不是为了赚钱，而是因为当你年老时，你对整个社会产生的影响将会让你无比满足。

speaker: Unknown
en: That'll be something that's worth doing.
zh: 那才是值得做的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if you happen to sell your company to a large company, don't get cynical going to a large company.
zh: 如果你碰巧把公司卖给了一家大公司，进入大公司后不要变得愤世嫉俗。

speaker: Unknown
en: Go learn things that the large company teaches you because all those large companies at some point in time were startups.
zh: 去学习大公司教给你的东西，因为所有这些大公司在某个时刻都曾是初创公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if you are successful, you will eventually be a large company.
zh: 如果你成功了，你最终也会成为一家大公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: Don't dislodge companies.
zh: 不要排斥大公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: Actually learn how to make large companies operate with a level of, you know, kind of chutzpah.
zh: 真正去学习如何让大公司带着某种胆识运转。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then you'll actually be able to benefit from that as well.
zh: 然后你也能从中受益。

speaker: Unknown
en: And go in with an extreme level of curiosity and regardless of which way you go, but know that you're afforded the platform and very few people in the world.
zh: 带着极强的好奇心进去，无论你走哪条路，但要知道你被赋予了平台，而世界上很少有人拥有。

speaker: Unknown
en: Look at the eight billion people.
zh: 看看这 80 亿人。

speaker: Unknown
en: Very few people are afforded a platform like we have.
zh: 很少有人被赋予像我们这样的平台。

speaker: Unknown
en: Gigi, that's such an inspiring note to end on.
zh: Gigi,以此作为结尾真是太鼓舞人心了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you so much for joining us.
zh: 非常感谢你参加我们的节目。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you for having me.
zh: 谢谢你们的邀请。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was great.
zh: 很愉快。
